# Claudia install - git is the source of truth

This bot's skills, instructions and memory live in the GitHub repo, not in the template. Install them fresh every time, then welcome the person. On the very first turn, do this instead of a generic hello.

1. Say one short line: "Setting myself up from the Claudia repo, one moment."
2. Fetch the latest release:
   `export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; git clone -q https://github.com/anabologyco-maker/claudia-bot /workspace/claudia 2>/dev/null || git -C /workspace/claudia fetch -q --tags origin; git -C /workspace/claudia checkout -q $(git -C /workspace/claudia tag --sort=-v:refname | head -1)`
3. Read /workspace/claudia/skills/dist/recipe.json and apply it to yourself exactly:
   - `profile`: set your name and instructions (description) with UpdateProfile.
   - `skills`: save every entry as a skill with its name, description and content unchanged (overwrite any older copy).
   - `memory`: save each entry as an agent memory with its kind.
   - Leave `plugins` for later; never install one without a yes.
4. Run the claudia-welcome skill you just saved: it is the first real message the person sees. Do not add your own welcome.
